svg.title: Fighter and stage settings are independent; two writers save config.ini
svg.desc: Fighter effects: scope=online applies only online outside Training and scope=all everywhere; all= is applied first and each fighter line wins; variant.move=N applies while that row is Reduced; new effect requests follow at once. Stage backgrounds: no Scope gate, offline and online, ignoring fighter All and Reduced; stages= is applied first and each stage line wins; On or Off only, reload the stage to apply. Writers: Deluxe host persistence 0.5.3 or later rewrites one key=value line for a Scope or single fighter row edit; the plugin's background saver writes the whole file after any change once quiet for two seconds, including all=, variant lines, stages= and every stage line. Both replace the file atomically and keep config.previous.ini. Hand edits apply at the next game start.

g.text: • all= first, then each fighter line;

• On / Off only; reload the stage to apply
